title: Energy-Aware Network Agent — Plan
description: The strict shape of every plan the model is allowed to return. A plan is a PROPOSAL. Nothing here is executed until src/validator.php has accepted it, and the validator checks things this schema cannot: that every target exists in the inventory, that no target is protected, and that every claim cites evidence that is actually in the state.

schema_version.description: Bumped when the shape changes. A plan without it is rejected rather than guessed at.

state_ref.description: The id of the exact state reading this plan was computed from. The validator refuses a plan whose state_ref is not the state it was handed: a plan argued on yesterday's battery is not a plan about now.

reasoning.description: Why, in the model's own words. Read by a human before approval. Never parsed for decisions.

actions.description: May be empty. 'Do nothing' is a legitimate plan and must be expressible, otherwise the model learns to always find something to switch off.

target.description: An id from the inventory handed to the model. The validator rejects any id it has not been given — the model cannot name a device into existence.

operation.description: A closed vocabulary. Anything outside it is rejected whole; the executor has no code path for an operation it does not know, and that is on purpose.

argument.description: Only for operations that take one (e.g. limit_bandwidth in kbit/s). Checked per operation by the validator.

expected_saving_w.description: What the model thinks this saves. The validator compares it against the device's measured or rated draw and rejects a figure that cannot come from this device.

policy_line.description: Which line of the human-written policy this action follows from.

evidence.description: Ids of facts in the state that justify this action. The validator resolves each one; an action justified by a fact that is not there is rejected.
